capabilities_done: Property::sample at exact EvalTick (i64, negative allowed): held ends, independent in/out interpolation (Linear/Bezier/ContinuousBezier/AutoBezier/Hold), hold out = step, non-interpolable = hold (MOT-031b), per-component temporal tangents {speed,influence} (single tangent broadcasts), cubic (time,value) segment solved by 64 fixed bisection steps, exact key endpoints, finite + hard-bound checks (OutOfBounds, never clamped)

Property validation: unique strictly increasing key times (distinct duplicate_key_time / unsorted_keys codes), component counts, influence 0..=1, NonFinite, MissingTangent, tick_overflow, dimension/key limits, stable key segment

Four-state machine (static|keyframed|expression_driven|expression_over_keyframes), retained static value (MOT-020b), revision + stale-revision rejection, expression error disables and falls back with disabled_by_error{code,span}, cancel never disables, Fuel shared allowance, NoProvider pure closure (unsupported)
ExpressionProvider / HostRead typed ports (no engine types), ExprErrorCode = MOT-259 vocabulary

PropertyPath validation; DepGraph::commit_expression (atomic, iterative, cycle participants in cycle order), eval_order (deterministic Kahn), ReferenceResolver -> ReferenceMissing / AmbiguousReference
DateProfile::utc_ms (MOT-256 exact i128 math, trunc toward zero, +-8.64e15 edge reject), civil_from_ms, to_iso_string (MOT-257), parse_iso_exact (4-digit and signed 6-digit years, UTC Z only)
EvalReceipt, DESCRIPTOR (valid JSON), report() through observe::SinkPort, example motion-consumer (--descriptor, --keys, --tick, --seed)

PropertyStore (insert/set_reads/update/evaluate_tick): evaluates all properties at one tick in DepGraph eval_order; evaluated values served as HostRead; reads limited to the declared read set (else reference_missing); canonical-tick read = evaluated value (incl. fallback of a disabled expression); other-tick read = keyframed/static value, unsupported for an expression-active target (no re-entry); one shared Fuel; store revision advances on accepted insert/set_reads/update, stale revision rejected; cycle/unknown/duplicate refused with the store unchanged; hard error (cancel, out_of_bounds) aborts the tick with no partial result and every property stays in the store

decisions.text: STU-MOT-033 (tangents per component) followed. research/adobe-behavior.md (AE scripting docs, UNVERIFIED black-box): a spatial position key has ONE path-speed ease, not per-component. Conflict recorded, not resolved: evaluator accepts either per-component tangents or one broadcast tangent. Spatial path-speed ease (MOT-036) is later scope (needs nib path length).

Segment with one Bezier-family side and one Linear side: the linear side contributes a chord handle (speed = chord slope, influence 1/3). Hold on the ARRIVAL side counts as non-bezier; only the departure out_interp=Hold steps. UNVERIFIED against After Effects; needs black-box valueAtTime oracle.

ContinuousBezier and AutoBezier evaluate from stored tangents exactly like Bezier; deriving/maintaining them is authoring-time (MOT-037/038), never in the evaluator. Bezier-family side with no stored tangent = MissingTangent.
NonMonotoneTime guard is unreachable for influence in 0..=1 (proved in keyframe.rs comment); kept as invariant guard.

Budget exhaustion (shared Fuel) is treated as an expression error: expression is disabled with disabled_by_error=Budget until set_expression/set_expression_enabled re-enable it (revision advances). Rationale: MOT-071/259 + determinism. A host that wants retry-without-disable must give a larger Fuel.
DEFAULT_INFLUENCE = 0.16666666666 per MOT-034a (AE easy-ease UI shows 33.33%; whether that is influence-of-speed vs fraction of segment is UNVERIFIED, confirm black-box before locking).
Seed carried as u64 in context/request/receipt only; no RNG (algorithm unpublished, MOT-074/076 gap).

PropertyStore other-tick read of an expression-active target is unsupported (expressions never re-entered: deterministic, cycle-safe). A host needing valueAtTime of expression properties must add a re-entrant evaluator with its own cycle/fuel policy (later slice).
